SELECT ft.id FROM form_flow ft LEFT JOIN form_permission fp ON ft.id = fp.form_flow_id WHERE (ft.type = 'CUSTOM_FORM' AND fp.id IS NULL)
OR (fp.permission_id = #{id} AND fp.permission_type = 'USER')
OR (fp.permission_id = #{organizationId} AND fp.permission_type = 'DEPARTMENT')
OR (fp.permission_id IN
#{roleId}
AND fp.permission_type = 'ROLE')
GROUP BY ft.id
